findings.control: version-4 native FIM proof requires the exact one-use internal scan object and binds scan/lifecycle generation, covered root, coverage counters/errors, baseline/snapshot digests, file identity/change token, prior and observed content, and change kind
findings.regression: direct mapping evaluation has no proof; a real bounded scan is accepted once and its replay cannot mint another receipt

findings.control: slotted lease authority contains no verifier callables and exact verifier implementations are captured outside mutable registry/class dispatch
findings.regression: all former dispatch fields are absent and unassignable; receipt-free evidence remains rejected after class replacement

findings.control: authenticated fixed head independently witnesses journal continuity; newer-fixed/lower-journal rollback, same-sequence fork, and non-ancestor states fail closed; GUI requires the exact current signed journal row and fixed byte bundle
findings.regression: journal-only rollback creates no lower fork and both inconsistent GUI handoffs are rejected

residual_boundary: Same-process hostile native code is not a memory-isolation boundary. Journal-only rollback is independently detected by the fixed head, while total coordinated rollback of every local witness requires a separately administered monotonic witness.
